title: SharePoint: dark mode support in the SharePoint admin center
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts match the roadmap, and its licensing and access statements match Microsoft Learn. It correctly distinguishes the Microsoft 365 admin center's documented dark mode from the SharePoint admin center's undocumented default and controls.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated what SharePoint admin center dark mode does on arrival, so its default is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: "SharePoint admin center" "dark mode"; SharePoint admin center dark mode default preference tenant setting Microsoft Graph PowerShell. Read roadmap, Manage sites and accessibility overview; only the separate Microsoft 365 admin center's default is documented.

claims.claim: No tenant-wide UI or automation switch for SharePoint admin center dark mode is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: SharePoint admin center dark mode tenant switch PowerShell Set-SPOTenant theme; Microsoft Graph settings. Read Manage sites, site-theming search results and beta sharepointSettings; searched full Set-SPOTenant text for dark, theme, ColorScheme with no matches.
